title: Code-bound register coordinate
statement: For every counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the register vector of $\sigma$ has value $\sigma.K$ at coordinate $5$.
replaced:
For every register state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the code-bound coordinate of
the vector of register values associated with $\sigma$ equals the code-bound field
$\sigma.K$.
